sources.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one finished alpha-transparent physics stacking-game sprite. Subject: a playful friendly white ceramic toilet with a deliberately wide FAT water tank on the LEFT and a short closed seat extending RIGHT.
Create ONE production-quality polished stylized 3D object, straight orthographic side-elevation, no perspective. Its overall width is 125 and height 115 in proportional units. THE TANK IS UNUSUALLY WIDE: it occupies the left TWO THIRDS of the whole object's width, so its straight horizontal top shelf runs from x=5 to x=83 on a 0..125 bounding box. The true exterior top plateau is 78 units wide, flat, crosses the object's horizontal center at x=62.5, with only very small 2-unit corner bevels. This extra-wide tank is an intentional funny cartoon proportion; do not normalize it to a realistic narrow toilet tank. The two friendly blue eyes and smile sit across the broad tank side; small silver flush handle toward left. The tank front descends nearly vertically at x=83 to the low seat. At x=83 begins the much SHORTER closed seat lid pointing right to x=125, with an exterior straight horizontal plateau around 38-40 units wide. This lower plateau is 37 units below the high tank top. It must still read clearly as a toilet, with a closed lid seam, rounded bowl below, and a modest under-bowl waist notch on the right.
The bottom is a substantial broad flared integral white-ceramic pedestal, not a separate plinth: straight horizontal true exterior flat bottom extends x=6..114 (108 units wide). Left foot lies directly below the left tank; broad continuous body connects tank to this wide bottom, with only a shallow concave waist at lower left. No skinny central stem, no separate stand, no wood, no accessory support. Entire object is ONE connected porcelain object, no holes.
All bearing surfaces must be genuinely flat EXTERIOR SILHOUETTE edges, not internal perspective lines or curved domed lids. Side elevation at exact eye level: horizontal lid tops and bottom parallel, no sloping top planes. Soft blue edge shading and glossy lustrous white glaze convey volume without rotating the camera. Charming premium mobile-game collectible style, juicy bright highlights, smooth chunky bevels, ceramic material richness, cheerful expressive eyes. No photorealism, no grain or grunge, no arms, legs, bow, crown, other props.
Centered isolated single complete object with generous clear margins. Genuine alpha transparent background, no scene, floor, floor shadow, backdrop, measuring arrows, diagram, text, logos, labels, or watermark. Every outer edge fully visible and opaque ceramic to a clean transparent border.
